Envoy: India Cannot Give Deadline on Sheikh Hasina Extradition

India cannot provide a deadline for the extradition of Sheikh Hasina to Bangladesh, according to Indian envoy Dinesh Trivedi. Hasina, 79, has been residing in India after fleeing Dhaka. Trivedi stated that "nobody can give a time frame" for the extradition, implying India had limited options regarding her entry.
